ask-question.sense: Putting a question to the AI about files, a folder, or the selection.

authentication.sense: A server or volume checking the user's identity (authentication required, rejected).

batch-rename.sense: Renaming many files at once from a pattern.

buffer.sense: A memory buffer or event channel that can fill up and overflow (the file-system watcher's).

busy.sense: A volume, device, or server that is doing work, so an action on it has to wait (the greyed menu marker).

camera.sense: A digital camera reached over MTP/PTP, or the camera that took a photo.

cursor.sense: The file-list cursor: the highlighted row that keyboard actions apply to.

date-wilting.sense: The date-color scheme that fades file dates like a wilting plant (green, yellow, brown).

debugging.sense: Diagnosing problems (debug logging, files kept for debugging).

deployment.sense: The name an Azure AI resource gives a deployed model.

entry.sense: A record in the drive or image index, or in a recent-searches history.

field-placeholder.sense: The example text shown in an empty input field, or the part of an example address to replace.

forget.sense: Dropping a saved server, password, or AI note so Cmdr no longer remembers it.

from-to.sense: The paired source and destination headings of the copy/move dialog, and the scan phase's source label.

github-issue.sense: A GitHub issue someone opens to report a problem or request.

home-folder.sense: The user's home folder, and the Go menu's Home item.

keyword.sense: A search term in keyword (not semantic) image search.

not-found.sense: A path, file, command, or share that doesn't exist where Cmdr looked.

on-device.sense: Running on the Mac itself, as the free local AI model does (a cost readout).

pattern.sense: A match pattern (glob or regex) that selects files in search or selection.

rate-limit.sense: An AI provider throttling requests that arrive too fast.

regex.sense: A regular-expression search or selection mode.

removable.sense: A drive that can be ejected and unplugged (USB stick, SD card).

reset.sense: Returning a setting, control, or zoom level to its default value.

runtime.sense: The software environment the local AI model runs in, which Cmdr downloads and extracts.

sidebar.sense: Finder's sidebar, and the sidebar of Cmdr's Settings window.

source-available.sense: Cmdr's license model: the code is public to read but isn't open source.

status.sense: The state of a server, file, index, or operation, shown as a column, pill, or colored dot.

striped-rows.sense: Alternate row shading in the file list.

subscription.sense: A time-limited commercial license paid by the year.

tint.sense: A faint background color applied to a pane by volume type.

wildcard.sense: The * and ? characters in a filename pattern.
